title: Transpose of ordinary unit-compositor transport
statement: Use the ordinary operations and specified compositors of [def-pur-finite-proper-product-maps]. Fix the finite coefficient setting P, schemes B,X,X′, and objects M∈D(P,B), K′∈D(P,X′), K∈D(P,X). For s:X→X′, q:X′→B, c:X→B with s;q=c, d:P_s K′→K and u:M→R_q K′, the c-transpose of u;R_q(eta_s);kappa_s,q inverse;R_c(d), with the indicated equality cast, is the pullback equality cast followed by comp_s,q, then P_s of the q-transpose of u, then d. No invertibility or properness hypothesis on s, q or d is imposed.

proof.text: Eliminate the equality c=s;q. Move d through inverse-Hom by naturality. The specified compositor-mate identity changes to the composite adjunction. Expand its Hom bijection. Counit naturality moves the s-unit next to the s-counit, and the left triangle cancels them, leaving the asserted pullback of the q-transpose followed by d.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteProperTransportTranspose (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B X X' : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ⟶ X') (q : X' ⟶ B) (c : X ⟶ B)
    (hc : s ≫ q = c) {M : D P B} {K' : D P X'} {K : D P X}
    (d : (pull P s).obj K' ⟶ K) (u : M ⟶ (push P q).obj K') :
    ((adj P c).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (u ≫ (push P q).map ((adj P s).unit.app K') ≫
        (kappa P s q).inv.app ((pull P s).obj K') ≫
        (eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (push P f).obj ((pull P s).obj K')) hc)).hom ≫
        (push P c).map d) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (pull P f).obj M) hc.symm)).hom ≫
        (comp P s q).hom.app M ≫
        (pull P s).map (((adj P q).homEquiv _ _).symm u) ≫ d
